title: ExplainCPE: A Free-text Explanation Benchmark of Chinese Pharmacist Examination
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The benchmark measures the ability of LLMs to generate correct answers and rational explanations for questions from the Chinese Pharmacist Examination, a medical domain.
findings: Not applicable. The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
